about.hero_subtitle: A family business founded on complementarity, trust and collective ambition.
about.story_p1: SIXORIA SARL was born from the meeting of six partners with complementary profiles, driven by a common vision: to create an agile, modern company rooted in African realities while aiming for international excellence.
about.story_p2: The name SIXORIA itself bears the mark of its founders: six individuals, six skills, one ambition. The two-part geometric logo — blue and gold — symbolizes the union of these complementary strengths.
about.story_p3: Founded in Yaoundé, Cameroon, the company is developing two complementary divisions — Digital and Trading — to meet a wide range of professional and institutional needs.
about.team_subtitle: Six partners with complementary expertise, united by the SIXORIA vision.
about.team_notice: Detailed biographies and photos of the partners will be added after team validation.
about.mission_text: To support businesses, professionals and institutions with digital and commercial solutions that are adapted, reliable and accessible — in Africa and internationally.
about.vision_text: To become a reference partner for digital transformation and business development of organizations in Central Africa and beyond.
